name: original-before
argv:
set -e; source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash; source /driver_work/install/setup.bash; if test -f /candidate-install/setup.bash; then source /candidate-install/setup.bash; fi; unset ROS_STATIC_PEERS ROS_LOCALHOST_ONLY FASTRTPS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE FASTDDS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE CYCLONEDDS_URI; export ROS_DOMAIN_ID=232 RMW_IMPLEMENTATION=rmw_fastrtps_cpp ROS_AUTOMATIC_DISCOVERY_RANGE=LOCALHOST PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 ROS_LOG_DIR=/review-evidence/roslogs XML_CATALOG_FILES=/acceptance-tools/offline-schema/catalog.xml GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=safe.directory GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=/candidate; cd /candidate; test ! -e /candidate/install
export MTC_VALIDATION_OUT=/review-evidence/before-replay
set +e
colcon --log-base /review-evidence/colcon-before test --build-base /candidate-build --install-base /candidate-install --packages-select mtc_vision_adapter --executor sequential --return-code-on-test-failure --pytest-args -ra --basetemp=/review-evidence/before-pytest-temp
rc=$?
set -e
cp /candidate-build/mtc_vision_adapter/pytest.xml /review-evidence/colcon-before.xml
printf '%s\n' "$rc" > /review-evidence/colcon-before.rc
test "$rc" -eq 1
